scenario: Anonymous requests a client, job, invoice, PDF or private file endpoint
expected: 401/403 or login; no private data in response, cache or search index.

scenario: Substitute an attachment ID from a different enquiry
expected: Reject 404/403 after checking the parent relationship; no unrelated bytes.

scenario: Request draft or archived project media, including resize URLs
expected: Public 404; neither original nor derivative is served.

scenario: Submit a cookie-authenticated mutation from an untrusted or missing Origin
expected: Reject under the exact origin policy; no mutation.

scenario: Two concurrent issue requests followed by a retry after response loss
expected: One invoice number, immutable PDF and issuance event.

scenario: Save a draft concurrently with issuance
expected: Issued data and bytes remain unchanged; late save returns conflict.

scenario: Concurrent partial payments together exceed the remaining balance
expected: Only permissible amount commits; conflicting request fails, no hidden negative balance.

scenario: Retry the same payment after response loss
expected: Return the same payment using idempotency; no duplicate ledger entry.

scenario: Edit client, catalogue and bank settings after invoice issuance
expected: Issued PDF, checksum, number and totals stay unchanged.

scenario: Preview and issue a short bilingual invoice
expected: Complete German page 1 and English page 2; same invoice identifier and amounts.

scenario: Use long German text and one exceptionally long invoice line
expected: Readable continuation pages; English begins on a new page after the complete German section.

scenario: Deploy the German-first renderer with historical issued PDFs
expected: Previously stored PDFs remain byte-identical; no automatic regeneration.

scenario: Issue with unconfirmed tax settings or missing required translations
expected: 422 with actionable fields; draft preserved and no tax assumptions.

scenario: Upload a spoofed image signature or excessive pixel dimensions
expected: Reject or quarantine before use; bounded CPU, memory and decoder work.

scenario: Finalize another actor's reservation or an oversized stored object
expected: Reject; no attachment or client association created.

scenario: Put SQL and HTML payloads in messages, names, filters and filenames
expected: Render escaped text; no SQL execution or script; safe download filename.

scenario: Restore an isolated database and matching object backup
expected: Recover expected synthetic records, files and hashes without production overwrite.

scenario: Submit English, Ukrainian and Russian messages with newlines and emoji
expected: Store and display the original exactly; reply language remains independent.

scenario: Upload three 5MiB photos, one 5MiB+1-byte file and a 15MiB+1-byte total
expected: Accept exact boundaries; reject excess; metadata request stays within platform limits.

scenario: Select HEIC, a corrupt image and a large phone photo on weak network
expected: Clear conversion/rejection path, bounded processing and preserved form.

scenario: Double-click Send and lose the acknowledgement response
expected: One enquiry per idempotency key; retry returns the original receipt.

scenario: Persist an enquiry but fail to send the acknowledgement email
expected: Retain enquiry and return saved status; no duplicate-producing browser failure.

scenario: SMTP accepts a reply but recording its result fails
expected: Show accepted/uncertain state and reconcile; no blind resend.

scenario: Use the same email for a household or several company contacts
expected: Offer duplicate review; no automatic merge or globally unique email failure.

scenario: Expire a session while editing a private draft
expected: No unauthorized mutation; recover safely, reauthenticate and recheck version.

scenario: Edit the same draft in two browser tabs
expected: Reject stale save with revision conflict; no silent last-writer overwrite.

scenario: Create clients, jobs and invoices concurrently at Berlin New Year
expected: Unique numbers and correct business year using atomic sequences.

scenario: Select FROM, PERCENTAGE or MONTHLY catalogue pricing
expected: Explicit agreed amount and valid period; never invoice a raw display string.

scenario: Accept an old or expired quote revision and retry conversion
expected: Reject or renew after review; bind exact accepted revision and convert once.

scenario: Attach an invoice to a job belonging to another client
expected: Reject the invalid relationship; no financial cross-link.

scenario: Rename a published project slug several times
expected: All old aliases redirect directly to the canonical route; no draft leak.

scenario: Use a missing translation or a legacy ua language alias
expected: Canonical Ukrainian remains uk; no false hreflang or indexable fallback duplication.

scenario: Inspect the footer on desktop, tablet, phone and at 200% zoom
expected: Retain live footer identity, verified links and readable layout without overlap.

scenario: Open, scroll and close the phone menu using keyboard and navigation
expected: Correct focus, visible content below header, no scroll bleed or hidden controls.

scenario: Compare an empty list with a database outage
expected: Distinct honest states; failure does not masquerade as lost client records.

scenario: Upload invalid STL, enormous mesh, archive or G-code
expected: Reject or privately quarantine per separate model policy; never execute on a printer.

scenario: Let provider restore history expire without an independent backup
expected: Do not claim protection; require real backup and isolated restore evidence.

scenario: Build both applications with deployed Node 24 and the actual lockfile
expected: Required existing/new checks and builds pass with compatible settings.

scenario: Create a portfolio draft from a completed job containing private notes
expected: Exclude confidential data; publish only explicitly approved media derivatives.

scenario: Exercise rate limits across replicas and behind a shared public IP
expected: Shared counters work with bounded limits and understandable retry guidance.

scenario: Open an unavailable template preview or purchase listing
expected: Honest unavailable state; no invented stock, sales or synchronization.

scenario: Schedule an appointment in an ambiguous or nonexistent local DST time
expected: Explicit timezone resolution; list and calendar agree.

scenario: Moderate a review with private photos and malicious text
expected: Check publication permission; safely render original; never publish private email.

scenario: Report invoices issued in a different period from their payments, with mixed currencies
expected: Keep period bases and currency totals separate; no invented profit.

scenario: Export CSV containing formula payloads and a large file archive
expected: Neutralize formulas; use bounded private expiring downloads and safe archive paths.

scenario: Compare 20% markup with 20% margin and convert grams to kilograms
expected: EUR15 cost gives EUR18 with markup or EUR18.75 with margin; clearly labelled.

scenario: Use keyboard, screen reader, zoom and reduced-motion preferences
expected: Operable controls, visible focus, announced states and no reflow overlap.

scenario: Load realistic public media on a phone
expected: Measure LCP, INP and CLS; use responsive derivatives with reserved aspect ratios.

scenario: Observe Neon managed-auth tables while custom login is active
expected: Do not migrate identity or enable public admin registration without a separate decision.

scenario: Inspect browser bundles, exports and diagnostic logs
expected: No database URL, auth secret, SMTP password, bypass token or unintended private data.

scenario: Request invoice cancellation when payments already exist
expected: Preserve original artifact and payment history; reviewed correction and balance treatment.

scenario: Download an issued invoice whose original PDF bytes are missing
expected: Specific conflict/operator recovery state; never rebuild from mutable current data.
